summary.text: Allie Phillips is the Democratic candidate for the Tennessee House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works in communications and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Allie Phillips graduated from McGavock High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Middle Tennessee State University in 2017; her listed professional experience includes communications and work as a caregiver.
Phillips ran for Tennessee House District 75 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent Republican Jeff Burkhart, 54.7 percent to 45.3 percent.

In a Ballotpedia survey from that campaign, she described herself as a lifelong Tennessean and mother who grew up in Ashland City and lives in Clarksville, and said she was running to restore abortion access and support public schools.

In her 2026 survey, she listed her key messages as putting working families first and making life more affordable, protecting and strengthening public schools, and investing in safe, reliable infrastructure.
She advanced from the Democratic primary for District 75 on August 6, 2026, and faces Republican Michael Lankford in the general election.
